_: Sets, roles and stats of the mint pieces for the ogre run game. Seeded by tools/gear-seed.js, edited in tools/gear-editor.js (pieces and sets marked "edited": true keep hand changes when reseeding).

swipe.name: Swipe
swipe.what: slashes the foes in front of him

chuck.name: Chuck
chuck.what: throws it high, it arcs down and goes through foes

smash.name: Smash
smash.what: slams the ground around him, knocks foes back

fore.name: Fore!
fore.what: whacks a ball that bounces between foes and walls

zap.name: Zap
zap.what: a magic bolt at the nearest foe

boom.name: Boom
boom.what: a long straight shot through a whole line of foes

guard.name: Guard
guard.what: circles around him all the time, hitting what it touches; one more each other level

buddy.name: Buddy
buddy.what: a pet that runs off and bites foes

spill.name: Spill
spill.what: leaves a puddle that hurts foes standing in it

stink.name: Stink
stink.what: a cloud around him that hurts foes nearby

flick.name: Flick
flick.what: flicks small things where he faces, very fast

plonk.name: Plonk
plonk.what: plonks it down behind him as he walks; it goes off when a foe steps on it

headwear.name: Hat Toss
headwear.what: throws his hat, it flies out and comes back like a boomerang, cutting through everything

variants.brim: light and fast, the brim cuts
variants.heavy: slow, hits hard and goes through foes
variants.magic: curves toward foes on its own
variants.bite: the hat chomps whatever it hits

outfit.name: Belly Bump
outfit.what: a shove all around him that knocks foes back

variants.plate: a small ring that hits very hard
variants.robe: a wide ring, a bit weaker
variants.fluffy: soft and bouncy, sends foes flying
variants.posh: foes it hits drop a little extra

fel.name: Doom
fel.what: foes take more damage from everything for a while

undead.name: Drain
undead.what: heals you a little per hit

arcane.name: Chain
arcane.what: jumps on to a second foe

pierce.name: Pierce+
pierce.what: every throw goes through 1 more foe (+1 every 4 levels)

luck.name: Luck+
luck.what: rarer cards, a few more crits

duration.name: Lingering
duration.what: puddles, clouds, burns and slows last longer

area.name: Bigger
area.what: +10% size and area of everything (+3% a level)

regen.name: Regen
regen.what: heal 1 health a second (more each level)

revival.name: Second Dream
revival.what: wake up instead of dying, once (twice at Lv 10, three times at Lv 20)

burn.name: Burn+
burn.what: all burning hurts more, and hits can set foes alight

thorns.name: Thorns
thorns.what: foes that touch you get hurt

flock.name: Counting Sheep
flock.what: every 10 kills a sheep joins your flock (up to 5), soaking up hits

focus.name: Focus
focus.what: its first hit on each foe always crits

burninggaze.name: Burning Crits
burninggaze.what: its crits set foes on fire

hypnotize.name: Hypnotize
hypnotize.what: its hits can charm a foe into fighting for you

contagious.name: Contagious
contagious.what: its hits can make a group drowsy

shootingstar.name: Shooting Star
shootingstar.what: every 25 of its kills a star falls on the biggest crowd

smug.name: Smug
smug.what: its kills speed it up for a moment (stacks)

moss.name: Moss
moss.perk: Plain old ogre: a bit of everything

crit_elemental_acc.name: Elemental Storm Cloud on a Stick
